# Beverly Hills Car Club

> Los Angeles dealer of European and American classic cars.

Concept note: part of an unofficial Kerblabs design concept. Facts come from beverlyhillscarclub.com. Confirm details, address and live inventory with the business.

## Services
- Buy classic cars in any condition, with nationwide pickup
- Sell classic cars: Ferrari, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, Maserati, Jaguar, Chevrolet, Plymouth and more
- Luxury car rentals
- Vehicle shipping
- Right-hand drive cars
- Cryptocurrency payment accepted through BitPay

## Actions
Plain-language actions an assistant can offer the buyer. At launch each one is wired to the business's real booking or quote channel.
- Sell us your car: send the vehicle details for an offer
- Ask about a specific classic: send the marque and model
- Request a rental or shipping quote

## Official site
- https://www.beverlyhillscarclub.com
